title: fix: redo record-list "Add View" flow — empty-name 405, invisible drafts, canonical naming (supersedes #2754)
body:
Closes #2767. Supersedes #2754 (please close it).

Rebuilds the record-list **"Add View" / "Save as view"** create path so a runtime-created view has **one canonical identity** and is **verifiable before publish**. Every problem the issue flagged in #2754 is addressed at the seam, not papered over at a call site.

## What was broken

1. **Empty-name 405** — the create dialog produced no `name`, so the client sent `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/` (empty `:name`), rejected 405.
2. **Newly created views vanished** — runtime views are written as `/meta` drafts (ADR-0034), but `listViews()` read published only, so the view never appeared in the ViewTabBar and couldn't be verified.

## How this fixes it (mapped to the issue's P1–P6)

### P1 — unified identity (`viewEnvelope`)
New `viewEnvelope(objectName, spec, { name, label })` in `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` emits the canonical ViewItem — `{ name: '<object>.<key>', object, viewKind: 'list', label, config }` with `config.data = { provider: 'object', object }` — mirroring the Studio `anchors.ts:createBuildBody`. The **qualified** name is used as **both** the `PUT /meta/view/:name` URL segment and `body.name`, so the `sys_metadata` row key, the ViewTabBar tab id, and the body identity all agree and the draft → read → publish loop resolves. `ObjectView` and `ObjectDataPage` both call the one helper (P6 — the duplicated envelope block is gone).

### Empty-name guards (the 405)
`MetadataClient.save()` and `createRuntimeMetadata()` early-throw a clear contextual error instead of firing a malformed URL at the server.

### P2 / P3 / P4 — draft visibility
- `DataSource.listViews(objectName, { previewDrafts })`: in draft-preview mode the adapter makes a **single** `MetadataClient.withPreviewDrafts(true).list('view')` request and uses the server's already-overlaid list (draft wins by name, `_draft` tagged) — **replacing**, not appending, so a draft that edits a published view can't double-tab (P2). No hand-rolled `fetch` of metadata routes at the adapter layer (P3).
- After a create in normal (published-only) mode, the console navigates to the new view with `?preview=draft`, so the `DraftPreviewBar` is visible and Publish is one click — the main-path loop is closed (P4).

### P5 — CJK-aware naming
`CreateViewDialog` gains an editable machine-name field, prefilled via `slugify(label)` for Latin labels and **required** (Create disabled) when slugify yields empty for non-Latin (CJK, …) labels — no more silent random `task_grid_mrsyt56j` keys.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Empty name no longer 405s; a clear contextual error is thrown instead
- [x] Row key, `body.name`, and tab id are identical (`<object>.<key>`) for a new view — draft read / per-item Publish resolve
- [x] Preview mode: new draft appears immediately; a draft edit of a published view does **not** duplicate the tab
- [x] Normal mode: drafts stay invisible, but the create flow provides clear follow-through (auto-enter `?preview=draft`)
- [x] Chinese labels get a user-controllable machine name; no mass random names
- [x] No raw `fetch` of metadata routes at the adapter layer
- [x] No duplicated envelope-construction code between `ObjectView` and `ObjectDataPage`
- [x] Existing tests green + new unit tests for the `listViews` preview branch, the envelope helper, and the empty-name guards

## Tests / verification

- New/extended unit tests: `viewEnvelope`/`deriveViewKey`, empty-name guards (`MetadataClient.save` + `createRuntimeMetadata`), and the `listViews` preview branch (single request, no dupe, `_draft` passthrough, non-preview unaffected).
- `data-objectstack` suite (89), `i18n` (42), and adjacent app-shell view/preview suites (73 + 25) all green.
- `type-check` passes for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/app-shell`; lint reports 0 errors.

## Docs / changeset

- `content/docs/guide/designing-app-navigation.md` documents the create → draft → preview → publish follow-through and the `<object>.<key>` identity.
- Changeset added (patch across `data-objectstack` / `app-shell` / `types` / `i18n`).
